commit.author: Timo Sulg <timgluz@gmail.com>

lines.content: - Plan agent produced a detailed implementation plan, verified against source files (vite.config.ts, package.json, nav-html.mjs, etc.); corrected two survey gaps (htmx.org dead code, topbar.ts real interactivity).
- User resolved three remaining open questions (stochastic-hill.md: include; api-key sitemap: include; RSS: include now).
- Plan approved and written to `/home/timgluz/.claude/plans/cosmic-chasing-curry.md`.
- Implementation not yet started.
- Created branch `feat/teeline-web-astro7-migration` off fresh `master` (which already includes the merged #357 pipeline endpoint work).

- **Phase 0 (spike/validate) — PASSED.** Installed `astro@7.1.3` + `@astrojs/preact@6.0.1` as regular deps (0 vulnerabilities after `npm audit fix` for an unrelated `brace-expansion` transitive DoS advisory). Wrote a throwaway `astro.config.mjs` with the full `vite:` passthrough lifted verbatim from `vite.config.ts` (preview2-shim resolver plugin, `optimizeDeps.exclude`, `worker.format`, `resolve.preserveSymlinks`/`alias`, `sentryVitePlugin`). Built a temporary spike page that spawns `worker.ts` unmodified and solves a 4-city problem via the `nn` solver, verified with a throwaway Playwright script against both `astro dev` (port 4321) and `astro build` + `astro preview` (port 4322):
- Worker-ready handshake, jco/WASM init, and `solve()` all worked correctly in both dev and production-build modes — result `{"total":40,"route":[0,1,2,3]}`, zero console errors.
- `@sentry/vite-plugin` hooked correctly under Astro's Rolldown-backed Vite 8 and uploaded source maps successfully (see note below).

- Confirmed a real, actionable finding for Phase 5: **Astro's default build output puts assets in `dist/_astro/`, not Vite's `dist/assets/`** (e.g. `dist/_astro/teeline_wasm.core-DgLgAxuf.wasm`, `dist/_astro/worker-C_ppXWee.js`). `scripts/copy-wasm.mjs`'s copy target and `public/_headers`' `/assets/*.wasm` Content-Type rule will need updating to `_astro/*.wasm`, OR set `build.assets: 'assets'` in `astro.config.mjs` to preserve the old name — decide in Phase 5.
- Confirmed `node:fs/promises` externalization warning from `teeline_wasm.js` appears under Rolldown too (pre-existing, non-blocking, worker still solves correctly).

- Confirmed only `teeline_wasm.core.wasm` is referenced by the jco bindings (`teeline_wasm.js` line ~7500); `teeline_wasm.core2.wasm` exists on disk but isn't referenced anywhere in the JS — pre-existing, not a migration concern, but note for whoever eventually simplifies `copy-wasm.mjs`.

- **Side effect worth flagging**: running `astro build` (spike) and later `npm run build:check` (existing Vite build, to confirm it still works unaffected) both triggered real `sentry-vite-plugin` source-map uploads to the production Sentry project (`timo-sulg/javascript`) using the local `.env.sentry-build-plugin` credentials. This is normal/expected behavior of the existing build pipeline (not something the migration introduced), but it did push a few extra harmless releases to the real Sentry project during this validation work.

- Confirmed existing Vite-based site (`npm run build:check`) still builds successfully, completely unaffected by the new `astro.config.mjs`/deps sitting alongside it — safe to keep iterating incrementally without breaking the live site mid-migration.
- Cleaned up: removed the throwaway spike page and Playwright script, stopped `astro dev`/`astro preview` processes, removed `dist/`/`.astro/` build output, added `.astro` to `.gitignore`.
- Surviving changes on the branch after Phase 0: `teeline-web/astro.config.mjs` (new), `astro`+`@astrojs/preact` added to `package.json`/`package-lock.json`, `.gitignore` updated.
- Next: Phase 1 (scaffold + config) — full `astro.config.mjs` with `@astrojs/sitemap`/`@astrojs/rss`, standalone `vitest.config.ts`, `src/nav-data.ts` extraction, delete `vite.config.ts`.

commit.message:
Log Phase 0 spike results for teeline-web Astro 7 migration

WASM worker + Sentry plugin + preview2-shim confirmed working under
Astro 7's Rolldown-backed Vite 8, in both dev and production build.
Go/no-go gate passed.

Implements [[tasks/teeline-web-astro7-migration]]
